messages:
faye_design: quick accessibility note from today's review: when tabbing through the dense model list the focus sometimes 'jumps' or leaves a ghost outline, and the skip-to-list link lands the row under the sticky header on mobile. Saw this on dark theme most.

oscar_frontend: I can repro. We added a small scale + shadow for hover and accidentally applied it on :focus too. That plus outline animations seems to cause a repaint artifact in Chrome.

toni_a11y: repro steps: Console > Models > Density: Dense > Tab rapidly across rows. Windows+Chrome and Mac+Safari both show a brief duplicate ring. Screen readers may re-announce the prior row. Also empty cells with tabindex=0 create extra stops.

oscar_frontend: easy fixes: scope transform to :hover only; use :focus-visible for keyboard with no scale; remove tabindex from non-interactive cells. Example CSS I'll include in PR.

toni_a11y: also add `role="status" aria-live="polite"` to status text so SR users hear state changes. For skiplink landing add `:target { scroll-margin-top: var(--header-height); }` or `html { scroll-padding-top: var(--header-height); }`.

infra_bot: note: if header height changes on responsive, make sure the CSS variable is updated via JS on resize so scroll-margin stays correct.

oscar_frontend: plan: small PR today with three changes: 1) remove transforms on keyboard focus, 2) audit tabindex and remove from empty cells, 3) add scroll-margin-top for skip targets. I'll add unit test to simulate tab order.

toni_a11y: I'll review and run NVDA/VoiceOver checks on staging once it's up. QA script: Tab through first 20 rows, confirm single focus per row; activate skiplink on small viewport and verify first row is visible; toggle a status and verify polite SR announcement.

faye_design: thanks — this will clear the last a11y blocker before making Dense the default. :white_check_mark:
